admitted_candidate.acceptance_rationale: High-fidelity developer platform operation. Cleanly bounded at recursion depth 2 with 10 properties (4 required: 2 path parameters '{owner}', '{repo}', plus 2 body fields 'head', 'base'). Completely self-contained; does not depend on pre-existing review or pull request IDs. Mirrors the collaborative authoring semantics of the disqualified issues/create endpoint without structural bloat or polymorphic object unions.
admitted_candidate.mock_feasibility_notes: Local mock execution requires an in-memory repository store that registers pull requests and validates head/base branches. Feasibility is pending extraction verification and implementation of the hermetic mock harness.

evaluated_rejected_candidates.rejection_reason: Potentially stateful dependency: requires a pre-existing review_id created in a prior review turn. Cannot be invoked reliably in a standalone single-turn benchmark without multi-turn state pre-seeding.
Requires specific line/commit_id diff context and pull_number; less representative of primary top-level creation actions than pulls/create.
Specialized virtual machine / container infrastructure provisioning rather than core developer collaborative workflow.

decisions.replaced_exclusion_reason: Disqualified from canonical cohort due to observed recursion depth 6 exceeding MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH=5 and polymorphic object unions across assignees, labels, and milestone properties.

admitted_candidate.acceptance_rationale: Core merchant balance routing operation. Cleanly bounded at depth 3 with 10 properties (2 required: 'amount' and 'currency'). Self-contained; does not depend on pre-existing customer or external resource IDs. Provides essential coverage of merchant fund movement without the bloated recursive depth (depth 6) and polymorphic address objects of PostCustomers.
admitted_candidate.mock_feasibility_notes: Local mock execution requires tracking merchant ledger balance and returning deterministic payout records. Feasibility is pending extraction verification and implementation of the hermetic mock harness.

evaluated_rejected_candidates.rejection_reason: Ranked #2 for fund routing (score 96, depth 3, 9 props). Structurally valid, but PostPayouts is preferred as it represents direct merchant settlement rather than intra-account transfer.
Requires a pre-existing connected account ID ('account'), introducing entity linkage statefulness.
Lifecycle mutation requiring pre-existing payout ID in path, rather than primary resource creation.

Self-contained with no pre-existing entity dependencies. Replaces the extreme bloat and 492-property depth-9 explosion of PostPaymentIntents with a rigorous, tractable complex contract.
admitted_candidate.mock_feasibility_notes: Deterministic creation endpoint; mock returns standard shipping_rate resource. Feasibility is pending extraction verification and implementation of the hermetic mock harness.

Depth 3, 11 properties; structurally valid, but PostShippingRates provides richer structural nesting diversity (depth 4, 17 properties, 7 required) while adhering to all protocol constraints.
